LightningComponentBundle.description: Flow screen component: opens Record To Open as soon as it is shown and finishes the flow unless Don't Finish Flow is on. Used by Convert Lead and New Lead.

property.name: recordToOpen
property.label: Record To Open
property.description: Id of the record to open, e.g. the customer Account.

property.name: skipFinish
property.label: Don't Finish Flow
property.description: Leave the flow open after opening the record. Turn on for flows started from a URL with retURL (New Lead); leave off to close a quick action window (Convert Lead).
